Verified receipts are not posted again. Existing owner allocations are deducted, and exchanges use their original FX bridge without repeating bank movements.

Keep full startup preparation and existing server jobs while reducing recurring browser work.
Refresh dashboard, receipt access, backup access and settings summaries when their data or account changes.

No balance polling, scheduled jobs or repeated background scans. Saved alert events update the bell without reloading journals.

Account balances omits a repeated currency when the account name already includes it.
The two display dropdowns have no visible labels and fit their longest option; Refresh and Close sit alongside the controls in one compact row.
